objectives: Explain why Isaac is called Abraham's only son.
Explain how Abraham's fear of God was proved by obedience.
Describe the oath the Most High swore to Abraham's seed.
takeaways: Isaac was counted the only son because he was the child of the promise; Ishmael was born of the flesh.
Abraham rose up early and went: no hesitation, no debating with the word.
They that fear the Lord will not disobey His word (Ecclesiasticus 2:15); faith and the commandments go together.
God provided a ram in the stead of Isaac: Jehovahjireh.
Thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies: Israel possessing Edom and the heathen (Amos 9:11-12).
